title: Portrait photograph of DDCI Charles Pearre Cabell in uniform, Chapter 2 p. 43
description: Dark, high-contrast black-and-white portrait of a man in military uniform with a "U.S." collar insignia, captioned "DDCI Charles Pearre Cabell." Text notes Cabell's close involvement in the overhead reconnaissance project and begins the section "Funding Arrangements for Project Aquatone."
